hypothesis: Establishing 2 untapped ER Queens creates an unanswerable endgame lock by disabling star-Ace and establishing mutual Guard against single-target removal.
independentVariable: Opponent board answer availability (presence of 4 Row Clear ER, 4♠ Total Clear, or star-2 Commandeer)
replayRetention: Retain replays of all breached fortresses
counterfactualUsage: Branch from fortress establishment evaluating opponent lines holding a Four vs holding an Ace
falsificationCriterion: If opponents breach the fortress in >= 40% of cases using 4 Row Clear, Total Clear, or star-2, the unanswerable lock hypothesis is falsified.
